newsitem.title: JAPAN: Japan will support 20 major banks - MOF's Mitsuzuka.
newsitem.headline: Japan will support 20 major banks - MOF's Mitsuzuka.

text.p: Finance Minister Hiroshi Mitsuzuka reiterated on Wednesday that authorities would fully support efforts by Japan's 20 major banks to improve their financial health, but he declined to specify what form that support would take.

He said the ministry's basic stance on the issue was that banks should do their utmost to resolve problems themselves. But he added that the ministry was willing to lend support provided banks had made sufficient efforts of their own.
"The 20 major banks make up the backbone of Japan's financial system. If they have done all they can, then we will support them firmly," Mitsuzuka said.
Asked what the word "support" meant, he declined to elaborate, only saying: "As I have said, we are supporting the banks' (restructuring) efforts in every way."
Mitsuzuka also said that market rumours about the financial health of a particular bank were groundless.
"According to the reports that I receive, there is no danger over a particular bank," he said.
